name: Orb of Dragonkind

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book. Artifact random properties use the game's condensed tables (deviations.md).

powers.name: Call Dragons

params.text: sends out a call to every chromatic dragon within 40 miles

powers.text: Magic action: chromatic dragons within 40 miles are drawn to the Orb, though not friendly to you.

summary: A dragon-trapping orb: healing and warding spells, Scrying, and a call no chromatic dragon can ignore.
text: Ages past, elves and humans waged a terrible war against evil dragons. When the world seemed doomed, powerful wizards came together and worked their greatest magic, forging five Orbs of Dragonkind to help them defeat the dragons. Each Orb holds the essence of an evil dragon. To attune, you must make a DC 15 Charisma saving throw; on a failure the dragon within dominates you. While attuned, you can cast from the Orb (save DC 18) once per dawn each: Cure Wounds (level 9), Daylight, Death Ward and Scrying; and you can call chromatic dragons within 40 miles. The Orb has two minor beneficial, one minor detrimental and one major detrimental property.
